serviceDescriptions.aliyun:
Alibaba Cloud's Qwen (Tongyi Qianwen) large models, strong at understanding and writing Chinese.
Offers enterprise AI solutions and custom services.
serviceDescriptions.anthropic:
Builds safe, helpful AI systems. Claude models excel at reasoning, writing and code generation.
Focuses on AI safety and controllability.
serviceDescriptions.azure:
OpenAI models on Microsoft's cloud, with enterprise-grade security and compliance.
Built for businesses, with private deployment options.
serviceDescriptions.deepseek:
AI models built for code generation and programming, strong at understanding, writing and debugging code.
Supports many programming languages.
serviceDescriptions.google:
Google's latest multimodal AI models, accepting text, images, audio and more.
Strong at understanding and generating multimodal content.
serviceDescriptions.lmstudio:
A desktop app for managing local AI models, with a graphical interface for running open-source models.
Downloads, manages and runs models locally.
serviceDescriptions.mistral:
Europe's leading AI company, offering efficient open-source and commercial models.
Known for fast inference and good value.
serviceDescriptions.ollama:
A framework for running open-source AI models on your own device.
Keeps your data private and works offline, with no internet connection needed.
serviceDescriptions.openai:
A leading AI research company with state-of-the-art models.
Supports streaming output and responds quickly, for all kinds of AI use cases.
serviceDescriptions.openrouter:
One API for many popular AI models.
Compare models and optimize costs; useful when you work with several models.
serviceDescriptions.siliconflow:
A leading AI computing platform in China, with high-performance GPUs and many AI models.
Suited to large-scale AI training and inference.
serviceDescriptions.tencent:
Tencent Cloud's AI services, including the Hunyuan large models.
Integrated with Tencent's ecosystem, with localized services for businesses in China.
serviceDescriptions.zhipu:
An AI company with roots at Tsinghua University, offering the GLM series of large models.
Particularly strong at understanding Chinese and in academic research.

workspace.examplePrompt:
You are a professional prompt editor. Improve the prompt below without changing its original intent.

Requirements:
1. Fix vague, repetitive, or unnatural wording.
2. Reorganize the information so the goal, context, constraints, and output requirements are clear.
3. Add necessary execution details, but do not invent business facts.
4. Preserve every variable, formatting marker, and key constraint.
5. Output only the complete improved prompt without explaining the changes.

Original prompt:
{'{{'}content{'}}'}

auth.title: API key rejected
auth.message: The provider didn't accept this key. Check that it was copied in full and hasn't expired, or create a new one in the provider's dashboard.

quota.title: Out of credit or quota
quota.message: The provider says your credit or quota has run out. Check the balance and usage limits in the provider's dashboard, then try again after topping up.

rateLimit.title: Too many requests
rateLimit.message: The provider is limiting how often you can send requests. Wait a moment and try again. If it keeps happening, switch models or raise your account's rate limit.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the service
unreachable.message: Check the address for typos and make sure you're online. If you use a proxy or a company network, make sure it allows this address.

localService.title: Local model service isn't running
localService.message: Couldn't connect to the model service on this computer. Start Ollama or LM Studio first, and make sure the address and port match what's entered here.

timeout.title: The service didn't respond in time
timeout.message: No reply arrived after a long wait. Check your connection and try again. Local models can be slow the first time they load.

model.title: Model not available
model.message: The service doesn't have this model, or your account can't use it. Check the model name or pick another model.

endpoint.title: This address isn't an AI API
endpoint.message: The server responded, but there's no AI API at this address. Double-check it; many services use an address ending in /v1.

server.title: The provider had a problem
server.message: Something went wrong on the provider's side. Try again in a little while.

generic.title: The request failed
generic.message: The AI service returned an error. Check the model configuration and try again; the technical details show the exact reason.
